problems.title: Next Permutation
problems.description:
Given an array of integers, rearrange it into the lexicographically next greater permutation of its elements. If no greater permutation exists, rearrange it into the lowest possible order. Modify the array in place and return the resulting array.

Input Format:
Line 1: An integer n, the number of elements.
Line 2: n integers.

Output Format:
Print the resulting permutation as n space-separated integers.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 100000
-10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9

visibleTestCases.explanation: The next lexicographically greater permutation of [1, 2, 3] is [1, 3, 2].
[3, 2, 1] is the largest permutation, so the next permutation wraps around to [1, 2, 3].
With duplicates, the next permutation after [1, 1, 5] is [1, 5, 1].

startCode.initialCode: function nextPermutation(nums) { let i=nums.length-2; while(i>=0&&nums[i]>=nums[i+1])i--; if(i>=0){let j=nums.length-1;while(nums[j]<=nums[i])j--;[nums[i],nums[j]]=[nums[j],nums[i]];} let l=i+1,r=nums.length-1;while(l<r){[nums[l],nums[r]]=[nums[r],nums[l]];l++;r--;}return nums;}

public static int[] nextPermutation(int[] nums){int i=nums.length-2;while(i>=0&&nums[i]>=nums[i+1])i--;if(i>=0){int j=nums.length-1;while(nums[j]<=nums[i])j--;int t=nums[i];nums[i]=nums[j];nums[j]=t;}int l=i+1,r=nums.length-1;while(l<r){int t=nums[l];nums[l]=nums[r];nums[r]=t;l++;r--;}return nums;}

problems.title: Leaders in an Array
problems.description:
Given an array of integers, find all the leaders in the array. An element is a leader if it is greater than or equal to every element to its right. The rightmost element is always a leader. Return the leaders in their original left-to-right order.

Input Format:
Line 1: An integer n, the number of elements.
Line 2: n integers.

Output Format:
Print the leaders as space-separated integers in left-to-right order.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 100000
-10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9

visibleTestCases.explanation: Scanning from right to left, 17 is greater than all elements to its right, and 5 and 2 are also leaders.
An element is a leader if it is greater than or equal to every element on its right; therefore the leaders are 10, 4, 4, and 1.
A single element has no elements to its right, so it is a leader.

startCode.initialCode: public static int[] leaders(int[] nums){int[] t=new int[nums.length];int c=0,m=Integer.MIN_VALUE;for(int i=nums.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(nums[i]>=m){t[c++]=nums[i];m=nums[i];}int[] a=new int[c];for(int i=0;i<c;i++)a[i]=t[c-1-i];return a;}

problems.title: Longest Consecutive Sequence in an Array
problems.description:
Given an unsorted array of integers, find the length of the longest sequence of consecutive integers. The elements in the sequence must increase by exactly 1, and the sequence is counted by distinct values; duplicates do not increase its length. Return 0 for an empty array.

Input Format:
Line 1: An integer n, the number of elements.
Line 2: n integers (the line may be empty when n = 0).

Output Format:
Print a single integer representing the length of the longest consecutive sequence.

Constraints:
0 <= n <= 100000
-10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9

visibleTestCases.explanation: The values 1, 2, 3, 4 form the longest consecutive sequence, which has length 4.
The sequence 0 through 8 is consecutive, so its length is 9.
Duplicates do not extend a consecutive sequence; the longest sequence is [1, 2], of length 2.

startCode.initialCode: function longestConsecutive(nums){const s=new Set(nums);let b=0;for(const x of s)if(!s.has(x-1)){let y=x,l=1;while(s.has(y+1)){y++;l++;}if(l>b)b=l;}return b;}

public static int longestConsecutive(int[] nums){Set<Integer>s=new HashSet<>();for(int x:nums)s.add(x);int b=0;for(int x:s)if(!s.contains(x-1)){int y=x,l=1;while(s.contains(y+1)){y++;l++;}if(l>b)b=l;}return b;}

int longestConsecutive(vector<int>& nums){unordered_set<long long>s;for(int x:nums)s.insert(x);int b=0;for(int x:nums)if(!s.count((long long)x-1)){long long y=x;int l=1;while(s.count(y+1)){++y;++l;}b=max(b,l);}return b;}
